printed.title: Cash Account—October.
printed.description: Printed cash-account ruling with column heads 'Date.', 'Received.', 'Paid.'

handwriting.note: Written across and around the printed title 'Cash Account—October.' (title not struck). 'scoter' written small in left margin above 'ducks' as an insertion; 'five' struck with '5' written above; word after 'made' appears struck/overwritten ('but'[?]). Later retrospective note (1881) in an 1880 volume.

Figures for jack, yellowlegs and dowitcher are written with crossing strokes (look like X / crossed 4 / slashed 5); read as 4, 4, 5 because the group total 60 requires 13 for these three. Subtotals 60, 7, 24 written in the left (Date) column with rules; a struck '7' above the second subtotal. Grand total 91 = 60+7+24. Retrospective 1882 record in an 1880 volume.

marks.note: faint ghost figures of the Game Bag summary ignored

transcriber_notes: Retrospective shooting records for 1881 and 1882 written in the 1880 volume's cash-account pages.
